content:
Lucas M.: ZenCorp sent back the questionnaire. Short list: per-tenant KEKs (HSM-backed preferred), cryptographic proof for audit exports (signed chain, exportable), scoped short-lived service tokens, and a forensic snapshot option for on-prem customers. Also asks for documented revocation flow.

Priya R.: We can enable per-tenant KEK with HSM wrap in Private deployments. Two modes: 1) Redwood-managed HSM keys (we keep KEK) or 2) BYOH (customer exposes PKCS#11 endpoint). Need clarification on whether ZenCorp requires Redwood to manage keys.

Noah T.: For Hosted/Dedicated we offer BYOK via cloud KMS today; envelope keys are supported. For Private we have a PKCS#11 shim but rotation/backup semantics differ — we'll note limitations (no remote backup of customer KEKs unless customer allows it).

Lucas M.: Auditor follow-up question: they want a step-by-step verification for the audit tarball (how to validate manifest hash chain). Can we provide a reproducible verifier?

Priya R.: Yes. We already produce daily signed bundles. We can provide a verifier script and sample signed bundle. Example manifest schema we use: 

```json
{"bundle":"2026-03-21T23:59:00Z-uuid","range":"2026-03-21T00:00:00Z/2026-03-21T23:59:00Z","sha256":"abcd...","signer":"audit-key-v2","sig":"MEUCIQ..."}
```

Noah T.: Important note on tamper evidence: we chain daily bundle hashes into a weekly root signed object. That gives cross-bundle integrity. We should document hash chain verification commands.

Auditor (ZenCorp): We'll want the verifier and a short demo during the review call. Also confirmation of retention windows and how we prove non-modification.

Priya R.: On tokens: we can issue SA tokens with TTL down to 15m, default 1h. Private clusters can enforce TTL locally. For revocation we have a revocation list endpoint that clusters poll; delta is pushed every minute. For totally offline airgapped installs, revocation is only effective via token TTL.

Ops Bot: Created runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/forensics-and-audit-export (sec-eng+oncall)

Lucas M.: For forensic snapshots: customer asked for full request/response captures for 7 days on request, but we must scrub KV cache and secrets. Legal needs to sign off on allowed redaction.

Priya R.: Proposed forensic deliverable: signed snapshot tarball containing: requests.jsonl (redacted), response-summaries.jsonl, manifest.json, signature.asc. No raw KV cache blobs. Include an explanation of redaction algorithm.

Noah T.: Example SA auth fail log line we emit: 

`2026-03-21T16:12:03Z SERVICE_ACCOUNT_AUTHZ_FAIL sa_id=sa-789 tenant=ten-321 route=/v1/chat reason="scope_mismatch" trace=xx`

Lucas M.: Question: Do we have metric on CVE remediation times? They asked for historical numbers.

Priya R.: Yes: rolling mean MTTR: critical=12 days, high=25 days (last 12 months). I'll attach a brief CSV to the packet.

Auditor (ZenCorp): Also confirm if FIPS-validated crypto is available in Private mode and whether signatures use RSA or ECDSA.

Priya R.: We can enable FIPS mode for customers in Private; signatures currently use RSA-2048 by default, ECDSA-sig algs available on request. Document this in the crypto appendix.

Lucas M.: Action items: 
- Priya: Draft KEK custody options + HSM integration notes (48h)
- Noah: Produce audit verifier script + sample signed bundle (48h)
- Lucas: Put together revocation sequence diagram + offline-cluster constraints (24h)
- LegalBot: Review KV cache redaction language and confirm allowed artifacts (EOD tomorrow)

Noah T.: I'll paste a quick revocation config snippet for Private clusters: 

```yaml
revocation_service:
  endpoint: "https://revocation.local"
  poll_interval_seconds: 60
  token_ttl_seconds: 3600
```

Priya R.: Scheduling a call: proposing Thu 9am PT to demo the verifier and walk through KEK options. Auditor, is that ok?

Auditor (ZenCorp): Thu 9am PT works. We'll expect a short demo and the verifier in advance.

Lucas M.: Thanks team. Please drop artifacts in #eng-security when ready. I'll coordinate the calendar invite and include Platform + Private-eng owners. :sparkles:
